title: SnowStreak: Ski Fitness Program & Ski Day Tracker
description: Six weeks of 20-minute bodyweight sessions before the season, then a one-tap log for every ski day and what your pass really costs per day.
hero_lede: Every season starts the same way: three runs and your legs are done. SnowStreak gives you six weeks of short bodyweight sessions before the first ski day, then logs every day you ski after it.
hero_note: Free to start. No account. Works offline.
alt_streak: SnowStreak home screen: 38 days to your first run, 14 of 18 sessions done, a 4-week streak and the next session, Power & endurance, 22 minutes.

before_h2: Six weeks. Three sessions a week. No gym.
before_lede: Three rotating sessions build the leg strength, knee stability and endurance you need for a full afternoon on the piste.
before_1_d: Short enough to do before work. Each session gets a little longer as the weeks go on.
before_2_d: Work and rest timers, an exercise demo and one cue per move. Squat jumps, skater hops, wall sits.
before_3_d: Every session has both versions. Switch any time.
before_4_d: Three sessions in a week keeps it alive, so a rest day never breaks it.
alt_program: Six-week program screen: Session A Leg strength, Session B Balance & knees, Session C Power & endurance, 17 to 22 minutes each.

flip_h2: On day one, the app switches sides.
flip_lede: Training gives way to your season log. Same app, no setup.
season_h2: Log a ski day in one tap. Know what your pass is worth.
season_lede: Date, resort, conditions, a rating and a note if you want one. SnowStreak does the math on every entry.
season_1_d: Your pass price divided by the days you actually skied, updated with every entry.
season_2_d: The day your pass beats day tickets, and what you save after that.
season_3_d: Days, resorts, best day and cost per day on one card you can share.
season_4_d: Every ski day, yours to keep in a spreadsheet.

privacy_1_d: Nothing to sign up for. Open it and start.
privacy_2_d: Sessions, pass and ski days stay on your device. No background location, no analytics profile.
privacy_3_d: On the mountain, where reception usually doesn't.
pricing_h2: Start free. Unlock the full season.
premium_note: Yearly plan with a 7-day free trial, or a one-time lifetime purchase. The price for your country is shown in the app before you buy.

faq.q: Do I need a gym or any equipment?
faq.a: No. Every session is bodyweight only. You need a bit of floor space and a wall for wall sits.
Yes. The sessions train leg strength, knee stability and endurance, which riders need as much as skiers, and the log counts a board day like any other.

faq.q: Does SnowStreak track my runs with GPS?
faq.a: No. You log each day yourself in one tap. There is no background location, and the app works fully offline.

faq.q: My first ski day is less than six weeks away. Is it too late?
faq.a: No. Start this week. The countdown on the home screen shows how much time you have, and every week of leg work helps on day one.

There is a yearly plan with a 7-day free trial and a one-time lifetime purchase. Prices differ by country and are shown in the app before you buy. You can cancel the yearly plan any time in your App Store settings.
SnowStreak is on iPhone now. The Android version is on its way to Google Play.

final_h2: The season is closer than you think.
final_lede: Six weeks from now, you could be the one asking for one more run.
foot_tag: Pre-season training and a ski day log.
foot_health: Training tool, not medical advice. Stop if something hurts, and talk to a doctor first if you are coming back from a knee injury.
